disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorder; clinical cohort applied to normative model (GAMLSS) built on TD participants; data span the full lifespan (infancy through adulthood)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "In total, our final sample included 1011 participants with ASD (females = 150, mean 12.7 ± 8.4 years)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Three datasets combined: ABIDE-I (N=393 ASD after QA), ABIDE-II (N=402 ASD after QA), and KQJH (N=216 ASD after QA); total ASD N=1011
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All data are acquired from ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II and KQJH." / "470 out of 2,479 participants in the ABIDE I & II and KQJH were rejected."
dataset-of-origin.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: METHODS / Participants, L41; RESULTS, L157

age.detail: Mean and SD from combined ASD cohort reported in Results (N=1011). Min age derived from KQJH ASD (range 1-6 after QA); Max age derived from ABIDE-I/II ASD (range 7-64 after QA). Dataset-level stats: ABIDE-I ASD M=12.72 SD=6.38 range 7-64 (N=393); ABIDE-II ASD M=17.04 SD=7.95 range 7-64 (N=402); KQJH ASD M=2.65 SD=0.83 range 1-6 (N=216).
age.supporting_text: "1011 participants with ASD (females = 150, mean 12.7 ± 8.4 years)" / "ABIDE I consisted of 393 ASD participants (N=58 female), age range 7-64 (M = 12.72, SD = 6.38)" / "ABIDE II consisted of 402 ASD participants (N=54 female), age range 7-64 (M = 17.04, SD = 7.95)" / "KQJH consisted of 216 ASD participants (N=38 female), age range 1-6 (M = 2.65, SD = 0.83)"
age.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: RESULTS, L157; Supplementary.pdf.md: Quality assurance (QA), L19

sex.detail: Female N=150 reported directly. Male N=861 derived from total N (1011) minus female N (150). Percentages calculated: female 150/1011=14.8%, male 861/1011=85.2%. Dataset-level: ABIDE-I ASD female=58; ABIDE-II ASD female=54; KQJH ASD female=38 (58+54+38=150).
sex.supporting_text: "1011 participants with ASD (females = 150, mean 12.7 ± 8.4 years)" / "ABIDE I consisted of 393 ASD participants (N=58 female)" / "ABIDE II consisted of 402 ASD participants (N=54 female)" / "KQJH consisted of 216 ASD participants (N=38 female)"
sex.location: Wang2023.pdf.md: RESULTS, L157; Supplementary.pdf.md: Quality assurance (QA), L19
